ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with approximately 5% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution corresponding to localized scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity field across both lobes; scattered high-contrast white linear streaks and small punctate clusters localized primarily on the mid-section and distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and significant depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys extending along the entire trailing edge from notch to distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on both the leading and trailing edges, terminating in sharp, slightly elevated distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Slight presence of circular white punctate marks scattered across the dark epidermal surface, concentrated near the trailing edge boundaries.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, unaligned white linear scratches and curvilinear rake marks distributed across the central and lateral regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy colonization of barnacles creating textured, high-intensity white/gray clusters at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique jagged distal tips caused by biological encrustation (barnacles), providing a distinct high-contrast silhouette against the water background.
